extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: 3-axle truck-mounted telescopic crane, approx. 10.1 m carrier length, 11.6 x 2.9 x 5.1 m (L x W x H) in this pose, boom 7.4 m retracted, wheel diameter 1.1 m
extras.notes: front faces -Y; 'crane-truck_upper' (slewing superstructure with operator cab, engine house, counterweight, luffing cylinder barrel) is a separate object with its origin in the slewing ring (rotate around local Z); 'crane-truck_boom' (telescopic boom with cylinder rod) is a separate object with its origin on the boom foot pin (rotate around local X, a negative angle raises the boom); 'crane-truck_hook' (rope, hook block and hook) has its origin at the head sheave so it can be kept hanging vertically; flat hierarchy (boom and hook do not follow the slewing superstructure automatically, the operator cab windows do); outriggers are shown retracted and static; 6 wheels are separate objects with origin on the axle (rotate around local X to roll); amber beacons glow softly; no brand, no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
